title: Name the link destination
hook: Three “click here” links hide which artifact each opens.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that people scan links on their own, so only a label that names the destination tells them which link opens which file

misconception: 'Click here' works as a link label because the sentence around it explains it.
objective: Attach a descriptive target label to a fixture link.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Three “click here” links hide which artifact each opens. Which label names the intended destination? Correct option: Report v3 sources. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
